dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

# Install system dependencies
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    git \
    gcc \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Copy requirements and install Python dependencies
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

# Copy application code
COPY . .

# Set Python path and entry point
ENV PYTHONPATH=/app
CMD ["python", "-m", "synapse.app.homeserver"]
explanation: Requirements.txt includes standard package names (e.g., gitpython instead of git, attrs instead of attr) and excludes internal modules (synapse, urlparse, tomllib). Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim, installs system dependencies needed for compilation (gcc) and Git operations, and sets up the Synapse homeserver as the default command.
